# HEM v0.6.1b23 — Per-device OFF watchdog control

Home Environment Manager now exposes a shared setting on each physical controller under **Safety · Post-shutdown watchdog** (localized in all 38 supported languages). It applies across heating, cooling, humidifying and drying without changing their separate PID/control methods.

- **Monitor and recover** (default): preserve b22 anomaly detection, suspected-fault announcements and at most two guarded native OFF repeats.
- **Monitor only**: perform exactly the same independent room-response checks and suspected-fault announcements, but do not send watchdog recovery commands.
- **Disabled**: skip post-shutdown monitoring, clear stale watchdog warnings and never send watchdog recovery commands for the selected device.

The preference can be changed while a physical device is offline or a native ACK is pending. Writes only update that controller's configuration; the OFF journal and retry count are preserved, and the controller's normal automatic shutdowns remain unchanged. The dispatch rechecks the current policy before any watchdog command. Invalid persisted values fail closed. Existing installations with no setting retain b22's Monitor and recover behavior.

No vendor-specific device assumptions, no extra background loops, no increase to retry budgets, no HACS/Marketplace changes.
